name: Anjan R D
specific_completed_work_2_to_3_sentences: Anjan investigated and refined the reference CMAB algorithm, including its feedback mechanism, observation features and safety constraints. He developed the training environment and conventional/LEO-aware A2C policies, conducted hyperparameter and multi-seed experiments, selected checkpoints using validation results, and exported numerically verified JavaScript actors for deployment.

name: Deviprasad V K
